scoringPolicy.earnedRule: A feature earns its full weight only when implementation, every listed automated test, and every required acceptance evidence item pass. Partial implementation earns zero weight.
scoringPolicy.externalEvidenceRule: Human usability, physical hardware, and stable release evidence cannot be inferred from automation.
scoringPolicy.regressionRule: No feature can pass while a related existing regression suite is failing. Tests may not be deleted, skipped, weakened, or allowlisted to create a pass.

features.title: 两模式单一真源
requirements: 新用户默认 serial 且 realtimeOptIn=false
设置、输入栏和多窗口按 revision 同步
v1-v10 与 streaming 旧值迁移
features.baselineFinding: Rounds 4-5 introduced the canonical schema-v11 nested document, v1-v10/bare/streaming migration, Main-owned atomic persistence with revision CAS, all-window broadcast, renderer stale-revision rejection, and confirmation-before-persist for active duplex-to-serial switching. Round 11 removed the single-main-window IPC trust limitation and proved one-broadcast synchronization plus deterministic revision-conflict convergence in two real packaged Electron Renderer windows.

features.title: 渐进式设置页
requirements: 默认只显示模式、设备、声音
本地设备测试不得连接 Provider
权限与设备故障有明确反馈
features.baselineFinding: Round 6 reduced the default Voice pane to mode, current microphone/voice and a local microphone test; all other controls are in an accessible Advanced settings and diagnostics disclosure. Round 12 re-audited TC-F2-01 through TC-F2-04: live-track validation, cleanup, permission/device classifications, unplug feedback and zero Provider starts pass. The SPEC-mandated named five-person first-user review remains missing, so F2 earns no weight.

features.title: 启动状态与结构化错误
requirements: 本地媒体错误具有 domain/stage/code/retryable/traceId
分阶段超时和逆序回滚
不得仅显示 audio 或原始 Illegal invocation
features.baselineFinding: Rounds 1-2 added structured local-media failures, visible startup stages, bounded stage timeouts, playback-before-Provider preflight, and reverse rollback tests. Rounds 12-13 fixed the CSP-blocked inline AudioWorklet, emitted it as a same-origin packaged asset, bounded readiness and every machine startup stage, unified startup failures as domain/stage/code/retryable/traceId, kept technical details out of user messages, and delayed Renderer activation until Main observes Provider session_ready. Packaged Electron media and live Provider runs prove first-frame closure, ready ordering, cancellation and cleanup.

features.title: 极简活动 HUD
requirements: 常态只显示状态、音量、暂停/继续、结束
features.baselineFinding: Round 7 reduced the main HUD to one of the eight specified user states, input level, pause/resume, and end conversation. Transcripts, transport, quality, network, usage, tools, conditional finish-turn, and immediate cancel are in a non-layout-shifting details popover. Manual interrupt was removed from the HUD and shortcut model.

features.title: 单一会话状态机
requirements: Session 与 turn 具有唯一 reducer
终态清理与历史 flush 幂等
React refs 不再各自决定终态
启动取消、恢复结束、审批接管无泄漏
features.baselineFinding: Round 3 integrated the session reducer as the Hook authority for phase, startup stage, session ownership, first-terminal semantics, and one-time cleanup/history claims. terminalizingSessionRef and phaseRef were removed. Turn/runtime/fault tests cover 10,000 duplicate terminal races, lifecycle, bounded resources, isolation and cleanup.

features.title: 媒体兼容与设备恢复
requirements: 真实 Electron 完成媒体与首帧闭环
features.baselineFinding: Round 9 added a reconnect preparation barrier so retry attempts wait for managed Gateway recovery and refresh the trusted local WebSocket URL, Gateway token and authenticated principal binding before creating a new Provider socket. Rounds 12-14 add packaged Electron media first-frame closure, 44.1/48/96 kHz resampling coverage, permission denial/recovery with zero pre-permission Provider Sessions, and packaged lock/unlock/suspend/resume plus forced Gateway restart with a new segment and one clean terminal event. Round 18 regenerated the complete fail-closed physical workbook against the current unpacked candidate; it remains ok=false and unsigned as required. The SPEC-required physical built-in/USB/Bluetooth and Windows 10/11 matrix remains unexecuted, so F6 earns no weight.

features.title: 插话和轮次自然性
requirements: Provider 自动中断不重复 cancel
正常抢话成功率和误中断率达标
features.baselineFinding: Round 15 separated reversible ducking from permanent interruption: the first 40 ms local speech-candidate frame now ducks playback even under echo risk, a cleared candidate restores volume immediately, and only sustained Provider/ASR evidence can commit cancellation. Provider response.done(cancelled) is now remembered by the Main runtime, preventing a racing local request from sending a duplicate response.cancel/truncate pair. Unit, fault/race, full duplex regression and type checks pass. The SPEC-mandated named 50 normal-interruption plus 50 acknowledgement/noise live listening result is still missing, so F7 earns no weight.
partialEvidence: test:voice:duplex-turns (first-frame duck, false-candidate restore, acknowledgements, echo protection, 10,000 races)

features.title: 可信历史、文字与工具
requirements: 无词级证据不生成 heardContent
工具审批、幂等、取消和崩溃恢复
features.baselineFinding: Round 8 proved stable cross-turn/concurrent/interrupted transcript ordering, no inferred heardContent without word timing, revision-CAS history, queued-text cancellation/restoration/retry, attachment rejection before draft clearing, formal tool allow/reject/timeout/cancel and duplicate-call behavior, and packaged Main-process force-kill/restart recovery with stable user/assistant/tool history and no draft canary.

features.title: Streaming 删除门禁
requirements: 公开类型、UI、Main 注册无 streaming 运行时
旧配置和 Thread 可迁移读取
仅 migration fixture、历史文档和白名单可保留 streaming
features.baselineFinding: Round 10 removed the legacy streaming Voice public contracts, Preload and Main IPC, Renderer hooks and UI branches, mock runtime, packaged smoke path, obsolete styles, runtime directories and invalid P2-only script entries. Round 17 reconciled the stale pre-P3 rollback manifest without inventing telemetry: it now records the authoritative P3 section 11 removal decision, requires the retired runtime assets to remain absent, and retains explicit streaming-to-serial migration. The deletion scan, migration tests, complete Serial/Duplex/M10 release regression and a rebuilt unpacked candidate all pass.
passedEvidence: test:voice-preferences v1-v10 and explicit streaming-to-serial migration
non-sourcemap out artifact scan: zero forbidden Voice streaming symbols

features.title: 非功能与发布门禁
requirements: 满足 SPEC 性能和资源指标
凭据/原始音频/敏感参数不泄漏
features.baselineFinding: Round 16 confirms the 10-minute acknowledged-uplink simulation, bounded timers/queues, fault matrix, privacy and opt-in diagnostics canary filtering, 17 development/production Gateway routing checks, and the complete duplex regression. F10 remains unscored because the SPEC requires a real 30-minute device soak, 10-minute physical weak-network run, current-candidate Windows/device matrix and signed tester/time evidence; the legacy audit-manifest conflict also prevents the complete release chain from passing.
partialEvidence: test:voice:duplex-m10 blocked at legacy rollback manifest
